requirements.summary: Publish the current draft version (Version 9) to production with a permanent URL accessible to all users
acceptanceCriteria: Draft Version 9 is deployed to production environment
App is accessible via a permanent production URL
All features from Version 9 are working in production
Production deployment is stable and accessible to end users

file_operations.description: Add a 'Publish to Production' section with a button that calls the backend publishToProduction method. Include confirmation dialog to prevent accidental publication. Display the current draft mode status using getIsDraftModeEnabled. Show success/error feedback after publication attempt. Only accessible to authenticated admin users.

Add usePublishToProduction mutation hook that calls actor.publishToProduction() and invalidates relevant queries after successful publication. Add useGetIsDraftModeEnabled query hook to check current draft mode status.
